name: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series — Manila Leg
short_description: A half-marathon event on October 11, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia Complex, Pasay City, Philippines, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series — Manila Leg is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 11, 2026, organized by RUNRIO Inc. It takes place at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay City, Philippines, and offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration for this event is currently open.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runner levels
Held at a well-known venue, SM Mall of Asia Complex
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., an established race organizer

excerpt_quotes.quote: Each location brings different routes and climates, so if you're unfamiliar with the area, it takes time to adjust.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Christine Hallasgo (2019 SEA Games marathon gold medalist and PUMA-signed athlete), quoted in Mindanao Times coverage of the Manila leg

research_highlights: The 2026 Manila leg is the finale of a six-city nationwide series and is held at the MOA Concert Grounds in Pasay City, with runners able to choose 5K, 10K, or 21K distances.
In the 2025 edition, the 21K category sold out across all six cities while 10K/5K slots reportedly sold quickly, so early registration is advised.

Race-day logistics include partial road closures on the course; walkers are permitted but must keep to the right to let faster runners pass, and wheelchairs, bikes, skates, and strollers are not allowed on course.
Finishers receive an official PUMA race singlet and a city-specific finisher medal, with an additional 'All-City Legacy Medal' for 21K runners who complete all six legs of the series.
The awarding ceremony for age-group and category winners is held on-site immediately after the race, and winners must be present to claim their awards.
research_watchouts: Registration for the series is strictly non-transferable and non-refundable, and you cannot switch your event category or city leg after signing up.
An elite PUMA-signed athlete noted that switching to unfamiliar routes and local climates across the series' different cities can create adjustment pressure that affects race performance.
Results protests carry a non-refundable P5,000 fee and must be submitted in writing within one hour of results posting — verbal protests are not accepted.

faqs.question: When is the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series — Manila Leg?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on October 11, 2026. It will be held at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay City, Philippines. Runners interested in participating should note this date as registration is currently open for those who wish to join the event.

faqs.question: What distance options are available?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at this event: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to select the distance that best suits their training and personal running objectives.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by RUNRIO Inc., which is responsible for coordinating the event details, including registration, venue logistics, and race day operations. RUNRIO Inc. manages the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series, including this specific Manila Leg held in Pasay City, Philippines.

faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series — Manila Leg is currently open. Interested runners can sign up to participate in one of the three available distances: the 21.1km half marathon, the 10km race, or the 5km race at SM Mall of Asia Complex.
